reason: Use the exact IPA #9 that crashed as the source; do not rebuild the host, framework or shaders. Its actual iOS profile gave the game only 4.4375 GiB app_pool although upstream NXNative's Mac profile allocates 9 GiB for Bananza. The crash occurs when the game's default allocator returns NULL for VoxelSceneHeap (0xb0e00000 = 2830 MiB); the resource-size table in the crash dump totals about 4.09 GiB across six heaps. Repack the same IPA with the largest single guest reservation documented by NXNative for iOS (6 GiB): 256 MiB front + 5.25 GiB heap/app_pool + 256 MiB stack + 256 MiB alias. mem_used stays 64 MiB for the loaded modules. Guest file backing remains enabled automatically because this 5.25 GiB pool exceeds available process memory. This is a max-capacity test; it does not claim iOS Bananza has already been proven.
